subject: Acme trial — procurement & conversion readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme trial — procurement & conversion readiness

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Validate that the proof-of-concept (trial) shows 3x improvement in inference latency for the core search workflow and <10% token-cost overhead vs baseline.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 50k monthly inference tokens, 99th pct latency < 250ms on p75 query size, and integration with your staging environment by the end of the trial.
- Trial period: We agreed to a 30-day trial starting when you onboard the first workload (you flagged Aug 18 as a potential start).

Open items / asks from Acme (please confirm):
1) Procurement path: will this be via corporate P.O. (preferred) or corporate card?
2) Does procurement require a signed SOW/Statement of Work or is a standard order form sufficient?
3) Any marketplace preference (AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace) that would make billing/commissions easier for your procurement team?

What I can do now: attach a draft SOW and our current pricing sheet for your procurement/finance review. Aditya (cc'd) will help with any technical onboarding requirements and Monica (cc'd) will be your CS contact for trial success metrics.

If you can confirm the procurement route and expected PO timing, we’ll prepare the final SOW and a DocuSign link so procurement can sign quickly.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_pricing_sheet.xlsx

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <procure@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & conversion readiness

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick answers and some follow-ups from procurement (cc'd Elena):

- Procurement path: Prefer P.O. for anything > $10k. For small pilot spend we can sometimes use a corporate card, but our legal team prefers a PO + standard terms.
- SOW vs order form: Procurement typically wants a short SOW (1-2 pages) that calls out deliverables, start/end dates and success criteria, then we reference Redwood’s standard order form for billing.
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace if available, but not a hard requirement.

Elena — can you confirm the expected PO turnaround (once we have the SOW & final pricing)? Also, any vendor onboarding docs or security attestations you need upfront?

Marissa — please send the short SOW and final commercial (we’ll review with procurement). Also confirm billing start date (should align with first workload hitting staging).

—Samir
Product Manager, Search@Acme
samir.khan@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>, Elena Torres <procure@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & conversion readiness

Great — thanks for the clarity, Samir & Elena. Next steps from our side:

1) Attached: a 1-page SOW draft (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) and the pricing sheet (Redwood_pricing_sheet.xlsx). The SOW calls out: trial start date (to be confirmed by you), trial length (30 days), success criteria you listed, and the responsibilities of each party for onboarding.

2) Billing start: we will align billing start to the date you confirm the trial workload is onboarded to staging and generating traffic. If you want to set a firm date now, we can also commit to Aug 18 as a provisional start and adjust if onboarding slips.

3) PO vs card: Per Elena's note, PO is fine. If you want to route via AWS Marketplace instead, we can pursue that but it typically adds 2-3 weeks for procurement reconciliation — let us know your preference.

4) Security & vendor docs: we can provide SOC 2 summary, IP/data handling FAQ, and a short vendor security pack; Aditya will follow up with exact artifact links.

5) Signing: Once you confirm the SOW language and pricing, I’ll send a DocuSign package and we can accept a PO number (procurement can upload a signed PO) or process via marketplace/card as you prefer.

Proposed near-term cadence:
- Mon Aug 17: Acme confirms procurement path + desired trial start date
- Tue Aug 18: Redwood provides onboarding checklist and staging integration window
- Week of Aug 24: Trial actively generating traffic; Monica will run weekly health checks and success-metric reporting

If that timeline works, I’ll finalize the DocuSign and loop in our legal ops to expedite any minor T&Cs.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_pricing_sheet.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <procure@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & conversion readiness

Marissa/Samir —

Thanks for sending the SOW and pricing. Procurement here — quick notes:

- PO path: we will proceed with a standard PO. Once you send a final SOW and invoice line items, we expect to issue a PO within 5-7 business days.
- Required docs: please attach the SOW (final), your W-9, and the pricing sheet. If you can provide the SOC 2 summary and vendor security checklist via a shared link that will expedite review.
- Marketplace: We prefer going direct (PO) for pilots due to faster accounting approvals. AWS Marketplace would be ok for long-term but will delay the pilot.
- Expected timing: If we receive final SOW and invoice details by EOD Aug 19, we anticipate a PO by Aug 26 which would allow you to bill starting Aug 27 (billing to align with production/staging handshake).

Please include a single point of contact for invoicing and a remit-to address on the invoice. Also confirm whether Redwood can accept electronic POs via PDF upload or needs a specific vendor portal.

I’ll follow up once the PO is issued.

Best,
Elena Torres
Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
procure@acme.com
